metaDescription: Order custom nylon lunch bags, boxes & totes with your logo. Durable, lightweight, and perfect for bulk corporate giveaways.
introHtml: Nylon lunch bags, boxes, and totes offer a smart balance of durability and portability for corporate giveaways. Unlike vinyl or canvas, nylon resists moisture and cleans easily, making it ideal for employees who commute or work outdoors. The foldable designs collapse flat for storage, while insulated options like the Out To Lunch 6-Pack Insulated Bag keep meals fresh. Add your logo with screen printing or embroidery for a polished, long-lasting impression on your team or clients.
heroAltText: Custom nylon lunch bags, boxes and totes with corporate logo in a variety of colors and sizes
